description: This source file implements a utility function 'HALUTIL_GetModuleName' that processes file paths to extract the module name, which is the directory name containing the file. It also includes licensing information and includes necessary headers.

methods.name: std::string HALUTIL_GetModuleName(const std::string & filePath)
methods.description: Extracts the module name from a given file path by removing the filename and isolating the last directory component.
